arguments.command: for t in v2 v2.2.2 v2.2.1; do echo "$t $(git cat-file -t $t)"; git tag -l --format='%(contents)' $t | head -3; done; gh release view v2.2.2 --json body,name -q '.name+"\n"+.body' | head -30; gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=closed\&per_page=10 -q '.[]|.number,.title' 2>/dev/null | paste - - | head; grep -rn "pi-action@\|cv/pi-action" .github/workflows README.md | head
